<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the monoisotopic peak is at m/z 224.120. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17 % and M+2 ≈ 1.6 %) is consistent with a molecule containing about 15 carbon atoms and no halogens. A formula that matches the exact mass and the isotopic distribution is C₁₅H₁₂O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H12O2</final_answer>
